Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:11:1.hebrew: דשומא הדר - נכסי לוה ששמו ב"ד לבעל חוב, חוזרין אליו אם נותן מעות לבעל חוב, כי הכא דהדר אפדנא למרה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:11:1.english: That an appraisal is returned - The property of a debtor that the court appraised for a creditor returns to him if he gives money to the creditor, just as here, where the mansion returned to its owner.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:11:2.hebrew: דשומא בטעות הוה - דסבור היה שאבדו הנזמים, והרי לא אבדו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:11:2.english: As it was an erroneous appraisal - For he thought that the nose rings were lost, whereas in fact they were not lost.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:11:3.hebrew: דהא הוו כיפי מעיקרא - שהרי בתחילת השומא היו הנזמים בידו ולא היה יודע, דאילו היה יודע שכן, לא שמו לו הטרקלין. אבל שומא שב"ד שמין על שאין לו מעות והוא חייב לו, הרי הוא כמכר גמור ואינה חוזרת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:11:3.english: For the jewels were [there] from the outset - For at the beginning of the appraisal, the jewels were in his possession and he did not know [it], for had he known that this was so, they would not have appraised the mansion for him. However, [in the case of] an appraisal that the court makes because he has no money while he owes him [money], it is like a complete sale, and it is not returned.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:1.english: We say - To the second creditor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:2.hebrew: לא עדיפת - מבעל חוב ראשון שבאת מכחו. כשם שהוא מחזירה ויטול מעותיו משום "ועשית הישר והטוב", אף אתה קבל מעותיך מבעלים הראשונים משום "ועשית הישר והטוב":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:2.english: You are not superior - to the first creditor through whose right you came. Just as he returns it and takes his money because of "And you shall do that which is right and good" [Deuteronomy 6:18], so too you [must] accept your money from the original owners because of "And you shall do that which is right and good."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:3.hebrew: זבנה אורתה כו' - בעל חוב ששמו לו קרקע, ומכרה או שנתנה או הוריש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:3.english: [If he] sold it, bequeathed it, etc. - A creditor for whom they appraised land, and he sold it, or gave it [as a gift], or bequeathed [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:4.hebrew: הני - אחרונים, או לוקח או יורש או מקבל מתנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:4.english: These - The latter ones, whether a buyer, or an heir, or a recipient of a gift.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:5.hebrew: אדעתא דארעא נחות - שיהא קרקע שלהם, ולא שיקבלו מעות. דאילו בעל חוב, אית ביה משום "ועשית הישר והטוב", דאמרינן: "לא היה לך עליו אלא מעות, והרי הן לך"; אבל אלו, קרקע קנו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:13:5.english: With the intent [to acquire] the land they descended - [Meaning] that the land should be theirs, and not that they should receive money. For whereas [with] a creditor, [the verse] "And you shall do that which is right and good" applies to him — as we say [to him], "You had [a claim] against him only for money, and behold, here it is for you" — these [people], however, acquired land.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:1.hebrew: ואנסיבא - אפילו לא שמאתן לבעלה בכתובתה להיות נכסי צאן ברזל שהן קנויין לבעל, אלא עיכבתן לעצמה להיות נכסי מלוג — הקרן שלה והבעל אוכל פירות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:1.english: And she married - Even [if] she did not appraise them for her husband in her ketubah to be nikhsei tzon barzel [iron-flock property], which are acquired by the husband, but rather retained them for herself to be nikhsei melog [usufruct property] — [where] the principal is hers and the husband consumes the produce.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:2.english: A husband - [With regard to] the melog [usufruct] property of his wife.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:3.hebrew: לוקח הוי - דין לוקח נתנו בו חכמים. הלכך, לא מיהדר היכא דשמו לה ואינסיבא ומתה וירשה בעלה, כדאמרינן: זבנה — אדעתא דארעא נחות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:3.english: He is a buyer - The Sages gave him the legal status of a buyer. Therefore, he does not return [the land] where [the court] appraised [it] for her, and she married and died, and her husband inherited her — as we say [above regarding one who] sold it: "They descended [to the property] with the intent [of acquiring] land."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:4.hebrew: ולא מהדרינן ליה - היכא דשמו מינה ואינסיבא ומתה, וירשה בעלה ובא להחזיר החוב וליטול הקרקע, לא מצי למימר "יורשה אני", דכלוקח שוייה רבנן ולא כיורש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:14:4.english: And we do not return [it] to him - Where [the court] appraised [property] from her, and she married and died, and her husband inherited her, and he comes to repay the debt and take [back] the land, he cannot say, "I am her heir," because the Rabbis treated him as a buyer and not as an heir.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:15:1.hebrew: באושא התקינו - כשהיתה סנהדרין באושא, שגלתה וישבה שם סנהדרי גדולה, כדאמרינן בר"ה (דף לא) גבי עשרה מסעות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:15:1.english: In Usha they instituted - When the Sanhedrin was in Usha, for the Great Sanhedrin had been exiled and settled there, as we say in Rosh Hashanah (daf 31) regarding the ten journeys.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:15:2.hebrew: האשה שמכרה בנכסי מלוג - להיות הבעל אוכל פירות בחייה, וגוף הקרקע יהיה ללוקח לכשתמות, ומתה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:15:2.english: A woman who sold [part] of [her] usufruct [melog] property - [i.e., she sold it] for the husband to consume the produce during her lifetime, and the principal of the land to belong to the purchaser when she dies, and she died.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:15:3.hebrew: בעל מוציא - גוף הקרקע מיד הלקוחות, והכי מוקי לה בפרק האשה בכתובות (דף עח:): תקנת אושא בגופה של קרקע לאחר מיתה. אלמא כלוקח שויוהו רבנן, וא"ל: "אני לקחתי ראשון". דאי כשאר יורש שויוהו רבנן, יורש שמכר אביו נכסיו בחייו — אין לו ירושה בהן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:15:3.english: The husband repossesses - [i.e.,] the land itself from the purchasers, and thus [the Gemara] establishes it in the chapter [entitled] HaIshah in Ketubot (78b): the enactment of Usha [applies] to the land itself after [her] death. Thus, the Sages treated him like a purchaser, and he says to them, "I purchased first." For if the Sages had treated him like any other heir, an heir whose father sold his property during his lifetime has no inheritance in it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:1:1.hebrew: ואם איתא לדרב הונא - שהשומר המשלם דמים נשבע שאינה ברשותו, אמאי חיישינן לשמא יוציא? הא אשתבע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:1:1.english: And if [the statement] of Rav Huna is so - that the bailee who pays money takes an oath that [the item] is not in his possession, why are we concerned lest he produce [it]? Behold, he has [already] taken an oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:1:2.hebrew: שיש עדים שנשרפה - דהשתא לא אשבעינהו, שהרי הביא עדים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:1:2.english: Where there are witnesses that it was burned - For now we did not administer an oath to them, since he brought witnesses.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:2:1.english: Exerts himself and brings it - He goes around and inquires about those who entered his house, and he will find the thief.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:4:1.english: And that [party] takes an oath - The borrower, upon whom the oath [rests], swears how much [it] is worth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:4:2.english: The creditor takes an oath first - That it is not in his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:5:1.hebrew: רישא דסיפא - הויא תיובתא לרב הונא. רישא — תביעת מלוה, סיפא — תביעת לוה, רישא דסיפא — דקתני פטור בתביעת לוה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:5:1.english: The first [part] of the latter clause - is a refutation of Rav Huna. The first clause [of the Mishnah deals with] the claim of the creditor, [and] the latter clause [deals with] the claim of the debtor; the first [part] of the latter clause [is] where it teaches [that he is] exempt regarding the claim of the debtor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:5:2.hebrew: אגילגול שבועה - דטענה שאין בה שבועה עם טענה שיש בה שבועה, מגלגלין עליו שבועה לישבע על שתיהן. וגילגול שבועה דאורייתא היא בקדושין (דף כז:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:5:2.english: By means of extension of an oath - For [when there is] a claim that does not entail an oath together with a claim that entails an oath, we extend an oath upon him to swear regarding both of them. And extension of an oath is biblical, in Kiddushin (27b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:6:1.hebrew: תהא במאמינו - הא דקתני פטור, במאמינו לוה למלוה שאינה ברשותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:6:1.english: Let it be [where] he trusts him - That which [the Mishnah] teaches, "he is exempt," [refers to a case] where the borrower trusts the lender that it is not in his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:6:2.hebrew: לא קים ליה בגויה - מימר אמר לוה, לא קים למלוה בגויה דמשכון, דלא נתן דעתו עליו לדעת דמיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:6:2.english: He is not certain about it - The borrower says [to himself]: The lender is not certain about the collateral, for he did not pay attention to it to know its value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:7:1.hebrew: מאי שנא כו' - דנקט תנא למלתיה בהכי, שזה נאמן על זה וזה אינו נאמן על זה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:7:1.english: What is different, etc. - That the Tanna formulated his statement in this manner, that this one is believed regarding that one and that one is not believed regarding this one.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:7:2.hebrew: לוה מקיים במלוה - מקרא זה, "תומת ישרים תנחם": אם לא שאדם נאמן וישר הוא, לא היו מעשרין אותו מן שמים, שנאמר: "תומת ישרים תנחם":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:7:2.english: The borrower fulfills regarding the lender - [That is, he applies to him] this verse, "The integrity of the upright shall guide them": Were he not a trustworthy and upright person, they would not enrich him from Heaven, as it is stated, "The integrity of the upright shall guide them."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:8:2.english: And they increased in value - More than the money that he paid to the owner.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:9:1.english: I was sitting - When he judged this case.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:9:2.english: And our chapter was HaMafkid [One who deposits] - And we were engaged in [studying] this chapter.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:9:3.hebrew: ואמרי ליה שילם ולא רצה לישבע - קתני מתני' דקני כפילא, והאי נמי שילם, וליקני רווחא דאייקור:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 35a:9:3.english: And I said to him: [He] paid and did not wish to take an oath - The Mishnah teaches that he acquires the double payment, and this one also paid, so let him acquire the profit from the appreciation [in value].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:10:1.hebrew: אטרחיה לב"ד - דלא דמי לאטרחיה לשבועה, דקני כפילא לרבא כששילם אחרי כן (בב"ק דף קח.) — דהתם משלם ברצונו, אבל רב נחמן הוצרך לגבות אפדנו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:10:1.english: He inconvenienced him [to go] to court - For it is not similar to [the case where] he inconvenienced him for an oath, where [the bailee] acquires the double payment according to Rava when he paid afterward (Bava Kamma 108a) — for there he pays of his own free will, whereas [here] Rav Nachman had to collect his mansion.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:13:1.hebrew: זבנה כו' - וא"ת: ואמאי לא מהדר? מה מכר ראשון לשני — כל זכות שתבא לידו! וי"ל, דהראשון מן הדין נמי אין מחזיר, שמכורה היא לו, שהרי אוכל פירות בלא נכייתא; אלא משום "ועשית הישר והטוב" מהדר, ולכך שני לא מהדר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:13:1.english: [If he] sold it, etc. - And if you ask: Why does [the second buyer] not return [the land]? [After all,] what did the first sell to the second — every right that would come into his hand! And it can be answered that the first [creditor], by strict law, also does not return [it], since it is sold to him — for indeed he consumes the produce without deduction [from the debt]; rather, it is because of "And you shall do that which is right and good" [that] he returns [it], and therefore the second [buyer] does not return [it].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:14:1.hebrew: לוקח הוי - אפי' אי הוי יורש לא מהדר, כדאמר "זבנה אורתה כו'", אלא משום "לא מהדרינן ליה" נקטיה; דאי יורש הוי, מהדרינן ליה, שהבן פודה קרקע של אביו. ואע"ג דבפרק יש נוחלין (ב"ב דף קלט: ושם ד"ה התם) מסיק דטבא ליה עבדו ליה, או יורש או לוקח, הא אמרינן התם: בר היכא דאיכא פסידא לאחריני, לא עבדי ליה טבא. ולכך הכא לא הוי כיורש משום פסידא דמלוה; ולא מהדר ממה נפשך, דאפי' יורש הוי — לא מהדר. ודר' יוסי בר חנינא מפרש התם, דלקוחות אפסדו אנפשייהו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:14:1.english: He is [considered] a buyer - Even if he were [considered] an heir, he would not return [it], as [the Gemara] stated: "[If] he sold it, bequeathed it, etc." Rather, it stated [that he is a buyer] because of "we do not return [it] to him," for if he were [considered] an heir, we would return [it] to him, since a son redeems his father's land. And even though in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Nochalin (Bava Batra 139b, and there, s.v. Hatam) [the Gemara] concludes that [the Sages] did what is beneficial for him — [treating him as] either an heir or a buyer — we say there [that this applies] except where there is a loss to others, [in which case] they did not do what is beneficial for him. And therefore here, he is not [treated] as an heir because of the loss to the lender; and he does not return [the property] either way, for even [if] he were [considered] an heir, he would not return [it]. And [as for the statement] of Rabbi Yosei bar Chanina, [the Gemara] explains there that the buyers brought the loss upon themselves.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:5:1.hebrew: מגו דמשתבע מלוה שאינו ברשותו כו' - לרבה ולרב יוסף לא פריך, אלא לאביי ורב אשי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:5:1.english: Since the creditor takes an oath that it is not in his possession, etc. - [This objection] is not raised against Rabbah and Rav Yosef, rather [only] against Abaye and Rav Ashi.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:6:1.hebrew: תהא במאמינו - ברישא לא מצי לאוקמי הכי, משום דהתם לא ירצה להאמינו, כיון שע"י כן לא יוכל לישבע; אבל הכא אין כאן שבועה, ואע"פ שמפסיד במה שמאמינו שבועה שהיה יכול לגלגל עליו, אינו חושש:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:6:1.english: Let [it] be [where he] trusts him - In the first clause, one cannot establish [it] thus, because there [the debtor] would not want to trust him, since thereby he would not be able to take an oath; but here there is no oath, and even though by trusting him he loses an oath that he could have imposed upon him by extension, he is not concerned.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:9:1.hebrew: ואותביניה שילם - וצ"ל דיוקרא דכיפי הוי שבחא דעלמא כמו כפילא, ולא דמי לגיזות וולדות, דאותו שבח ניכר בגוף הבהמה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 35a:9:1.english: And I raised an objection to him: "[If] he paid..." - And one must say that the appreciation in value of the jewels is an external gain, like the double payment, and it is not similar to shearings and offspring, for that gain is recognizable in the body of the animal.
